propositions: rebar search does not match tickets by their canonical ticket_id, human alias, or bound Jira key because _haystack excludes these identifiers from the searchable text
A user can run rebar show REB-1654 and get a result but rebar search REB-1654 returns empty, leading them to wrongly conclude the ticket does not exist
Identifier matching must be case-insensitive so that search REB-1654 and search reb-1654 both surface the bound ticket
search_states reducer must remain pure without filesystem/binding-store access; Jira-key enrichment must happen in the caller search_state before search_states is invoked
